006package dev.metaschema.databind.io.xml;
007
008import javax.xml.stream.EventFilter;
009import javax.xml.stream.XMLStreamConstants;
010import javax.xml.stream.events.XMLEvent;
011
012/**
013 * An XML event filter that excludes comment events from the event stream.
014 * <p>
015 * This filter is used during XML parsing to skip over comment nodes, allowing
016 * the parser to focus only on meaningful content.
017 */
018public class CommentFilter implements EventFilter {
019
020  @Override
021  public boolean accept(XMLEvent event) {
022    return event.getEventType() != XMLStreamConstants.COMMENT;
023  }
024
025}
